moveBanner.title: The app is moving to use.privacynotes.app
moveBanner.body: Move this session over now - it takes a few seconds and your notes come with you.
moveBanner.error: Couldn't sync everything just now. Check your connection and try again.
moveBanner.conflict: One of your notes has a sync conflict that needs your decision. Resolve it in the dialog, then try again.

movedHint.body: This is the app's new home. Update your bookmark to use.privacynotes.app and re-add any home screen shortcut.

moveScreen.title: The app has moved to use.privacynotes.app
moveScreen.body: Move this device over now - it takes a few seconds and your notes come with you. Nothing is deleted here.
moveScreen.openNotes: Open your notes here once to fix this

frozen.configured: Sync paused. You've been over your storage limit for 90+ days. Your notes are safe locally. Re-subscribe or export your data.
frozen.unconfigured: Sync paused. You've been over your storage limit for 90+ days. Your notes are safe locally. Export and trim notes to resume sync.

grace.configured_one: Storage add-on expired. {{count}} day left to reduce usage or re-subscribe before sync pauses.
grace.configured_other: Storage add-on expired. {{count}} days left to reduce usage or re-subscribe before sync pauses.
grace.unconfigured_one: Over your storage limit. {{count}} day left to trim notes before sync pauses.
grace.unconfigured_other: Over your storage limit. {{count}} days left to trim notes before sync pauses.

full.configured: Storage full. Some notes couldn't sync. Free up space or add more storage.
full.unconfigured: Storage full. Some notes couldn't sync. Free up space by trimming notes.

syncError.failed_one: 1 note failed to sync. It'll retry automatically.
syncError.failed_other: {{count}} notes failed to sync. They'll retry automatically.

sessionExpired.title: Session expired
sessionExpired.body: Your session has expired. Your notes are safe on this device. Sign in again to resume syncing.

signOutConfirm.title: Did you save your 12-word phrase?
signOutConfirm.body: Your phrase is the <only>only</only> way back in. No email reset, no support line. We don't know who you are, by design. If you haven't written it down yet, tap <action>No, show phrase</action> and we'll open it for you right now.
signOutConfirm.unsyncedWarn_one: 1 note on this device hasn't synced yet. It will be permanently lost if it can't be uploaded while signing out.
signOutConfirm.unsyncedWarn_other: {{count}} notes on this device haven't synced yet. They will be permanently lost if they can't be uploaded while signing out.
signOutConfirm.unsyncedKept_one: 1 note on this device hasn't synced yet. It stays on this device and syncs after you sign in again.
signOutConfirm.unsyncedKept_other: {{count}} notes on this device haven't synced yet. They stay on this device and sync after you sign in again.
signOutConfirm.appLockHint: Shared device? Turn on app lock under Settings > Security.

burnShareModal.title: Share & Burn After Reading
burnShareModal.body: <lead>Your original note will not be deleted.</lead> It stays safe in your account. The burn link is a separate encrypted copy that self-destructs after being read. Link expires after 24 hours, whether opened or not.
burnShareModal.imagesStripped: Only text is shown, files are hidden in this note.

burnView.footerTagline: - Zero-knowledge encrypted notes, hosted in Switzerland.

sealed.heading: You received an encrypted note.
sealed.subheading: This message will self-destruct after reading. Unread links expire after 24 hours.
sealed.warning: The server deletes the note the moment you reveal it. No second chances.

revealed.deletedNotice: This shared copy has been deleted from the server. It cannot be viewed again.

destroyed.heading: Message destroyed.
destroyed.body: Deleted from the server and cleared from memory. This message cannot be read again.

gone.heading: This note is gone.
gone.body: It was already read or has expired. Burn links can only be opened once and expire after 24 hours.

error.heading: Something went wrong.
error.fallback: The link may be corrupted or incomplete.
error.server: Server error. The note may have already been read or expired.
error.decryption: Decryption failed. The link may be corrupted.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

noPayload.heading: No message found.
noPayload.body: This URL doesn’t contain a burn note reference. Make sure you have the complete link.

burnShare.offline: You're offline. Burn links require a server round-trip. Try again when you're back online.
burnShare.demo: Burn links are stored on a server, and the demo never contacts one. Sign up to create real burn links.
burnShare.tooLarge: Note is too large to share via burn link ({{size}}KB). Maximum is {{max}}KB.
burnShare.storeFailed: Failed to store burn note on server.
